description: From island hopping around El Nido and exploring the crystal-clear lagoons of Coron to surfing in Siargao, swimming through the famous sardine run and chasing waterfalls in Cebu, these are the experiences that make the Philippines unforgettable. 📌 Save this for your Philippines itinerary and send it to your travel buddy!
